text:
sara: Quick follow-up from this morning's sync 12 I'm exploring a different admission model for dedicated GPU pools: short-duration 'time-window reservations' (TWR) instead of persistent credit tokens.
ajay: what's the motivation vs our current credit + headroom system?
sara: Credits are leaky: bursty tenants burn them fast, then the system prewarms aggressively and costs spike. Also cross-shard accounting gets hairy when credits linger.
leo: ok. High level of TWR?
sara: Tenants acquire a window (e.g., 30s) which grants N concurrent slots on a shard. Windows auto-expire; sustained demand promotes to a soft persistent lease. Windows can be held on multiple shards.
jenna: how do we avoid paying warmup for every window?
sara: two levers: prewarm coalescing (group closely timed windows) and promotion hysteresis (promote only after sustained windows, e.g., 3 windows in 60s).
ajay: admission policy priorities?
sara: SLA tier > realtime > cost band, plus probabilistic thinning for best-effort when headroom tight (admit with p<1).
leo: paste a tiny config sketch pls
sara: ```
admission:
  window_size: 30s
  slots_per_window: 4
  prewarm_coalesce_ms: 200
  promotion_threshold: 3_windows_in_60s
  thinning:
    best_effort_prob: 0.6
```
jenna: cross-shard coord concerns?
sara: keep a compact global lease-index (monotonic counters) for promotions/quotas. Accept approximate global view for admission but enforce local safety limits.
ajay: billing implications?
sara: bill by window-seconds (window_size * slots_used). For promoted leases we reconcile with actual runtime usage.
leo: SLO impact?
sara: sims show cold-starts drop for bursty traffic; p99 risk if coalescing too wide. Tunable.
jenna: client retry behavior?
sara: we'll return 429 with `Retry-After: window-backoff-ms` hint and SDK will do tenant-keyed exponential backoff.
autoscaler-bot: notice: prewarm events +18% in last 10m; suggest increase prewarm_coalesce_ms to 350ms for test shard.
ajay: for RFC include operator handoff and emergency controls: shrink window_size, strict admission, disable promotions; rollback is config revert and let windows expire.
sara: testing plan: shadow admission in prod with canary tenants + synthetic bursts, 24h compare: cold-starts, cost/token, p99.
jenna: add dashboards: windows-in-flight, promotions/sec, prewarm-coalesces, thinning-rejects.
leo: I'll help with simulation harness config.
ajay: I'll pair on the cost model section.
sara: thanks all, I'll draft the RFC and ping reviews :tada:
